MEDIA_SCOPE_DENIED: Locate the media or subtitle file again.
MEDIA_PROBE_FAILED: Check FFprobe health or choose another local media file.
MEDIA_UNSUPPORTED: Review codec details and the conversion support matrix.
PLAYBACK_DECODE_FAILED: Try the next deterministic playback plan.
CONVERSION_REQUIRED: Review time and disk cost, then explicitly approve video conversion.
CONVERSION_FAILED: Check FFmpeg health, free space, and retry.
CONVERSION_CANCELLED: Restart the compatibility conversion when ready.
SUBTITLE_AMBIGUOUS: Choose one of the tied subtitle sources.
SUBTITLE_IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED: Choose an SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, or embedded text track.
DICTIONARY_UNAVAILABLE: Import the checksummed local JMdict database.
FFMPEG_NOT_FOUND: Install FFmpeg or choose the executable in Settings.
ANKI_OFFLINE: Start Anki Desktop and verify AnkiConnect.
ANKI_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: Remap deck, note type, and fields.
PUBLISH_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN: Reconcile by the mining marker before retrying.
INVALID_REQUEST: Refresh the current media state and retry the action.
STALE_REVISION: Review the refreshed subtitle or draft before retrying.
STORAGE_FAILED: Check available disk space and application data permissions.
